finalists.label: Silicone Oil-Induced Maculopathy
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye and oil bubbles within a lamellar macular hole.

finalists.label: Silicone oil syndrome
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including emulsified silicone oil forming a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye and oil bubbles within its boundaries.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has specific for evidence that is not shared with its rival, including the formation of a meniscus in the fovea of the left eye.
